question: Which Indian legendary sportsperson became the first Asian man to be inducted into the Tennis Hall of Fame?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leander Paes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Leander Paes is a renowned Indian tennis player known for his outstanding achievements in doubles and mixed doubles events.
 
• He was inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in 2021, becoming the first Asian man to receive this honor.
 
• Paes has won 18 Grand Slam titles, including eight in men's doubles and ten in mixed doubles.
 
• He is considered one of the greatest doubles players in the history of tennis, with a career spanning over three decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Tennis Hall of Fame**

 
 
• It is a non-profit organization that preserves and promotes the history of tennis and celebrates its champions.
 
• Located in Newport, Rhode Island, USA, the Hall of Fame was established in 1954.
 
• Induction into the Hall of Fame is considered one of the highest honors in the sport of tennis.
 
 
 
• **Grand Slam Titles**
 
 
• The four Grand Slam tournaments are the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, and US Open.
 
• Winning all four in a single year is known as a "Calendar Grand Slam," a rare and prestigious achievement.
 
• Leander Paes has won titles in both men's doubles and mixed doubles categories across these tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Davis Cup**
 
 
• Leander Paes has represented India in the Davis Cup, the premier international team event in men's tennis.
 
• He holds the record for the most Davis Cup doubles wins by an Indian player.
 
 
 
• **Olympics**
 
 
• Leander Paes won a bronze medal in singles at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics, marking India's first Olympic tennis medal.
 
• He has participated in seven consecutive Olympic Games, a record for an Indian athlete.
